candidates.title: BPR-0794: readable diff and exact epochs after the Git sampling repair
criteria: The current tests-disabled CLI-profile app shows the correct file list and a readable selected diff for EpicGames/UnrealEngine#1773, with source and review-thread anchors belonging to its accepted epoch pair and Right OID matching the pull request's current head.
candidates.content:
This v004 build fixes the reproduced Git temporary-file sampling race that wrongly reported response_limit. Three production-bridge reads now pass. Participant rows use one line, and the Overview opens immediately with progress. Those checks do not replace your exact-target source/anchor verdict.

Quit the old BetterPullReview normally, then launch the absolute-path build below. Use the already opted-in GitHub CLI profile and open the exact target once. Do not sign out, repeat device sign-in, switch the global gh account or handle credentials. If that CLI account is unavailable, reject with the fixed blocker and stop.

Compare Files changed with GitHub (previously 1,523), select a changed text file, and require a readable diff. In Review details, require both sides available. Check Right OID against the current GitHub head, source lines against GitHub, and a review-thread anchor on that file if present. Accept only if they agree; otherwise name the failed step or fixed status. Keep private paths, source, OIDs, thread text and screenshots out of notes. No GitHub write is requested. Use this same read for the loading question; the accepted device-relaunch result is not being repeated.

launch.label: After quitting the old app, open v004

copy.label: Check for an old app process (no output means none)

candidates.title: BPR-0795: immediate Overview, visible progress and explicit readiness
criteria: Opening the exact target immediately shows a full-width Overview with loading progress; PR and selected-file work remain responsive, and their pending, ready or failed states are clear.
candidates.content:
Use the same v004 app and read as the diff question. Do not start a second read or repeat the accepted device-relaunch check.

On Return from Home, the full-width Overview should appear immediately, while details, files and conversations load in the background. Its top strip should show the current stage and received-page count, then distinguish comparison preparation from readiness or an actionable failure. Selecting a file should promptly show its own loading state and then a readable comparison or explicit refusal. Move or resize the window during pending work.

Accept if those transitions are prompt, understandable and responsive. Otherwise reject with the late/missing transition, fixed status and approximate seconds. No private content is needed. The prior provider snapshot took about 75 seconds; this build does not promise a short total network duration or percentage with an unknown total. Small reviews still acquire complete comparisons in the background; only accepted large reviews defer selected-file and older-epoch objects. Those policy branches are automated checks, not extra questions.

launch.label: Use the same v004 app as the diff question
